notes.title: [PATCH NOTES]8/4/2016
notes.content:
Patch V 1.1 was released today.

PATCH NOTES
• Fixed bug where BGM and voices would randomly stop. 
• Fixed white screen freeze after solving certain puzzle rooms. 
• Fixed flickering in certain puzzle rooms

If you are still experiencing issues after the patch, or if the patch introduced new issue, please let us know on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/311240/discussions/1/353915953247820951/]the forums[/url]. 
This patch overrides the Beta branch and the Beta has been closed with this update. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: [BETA PATCH NOTES] 7/12/2016
notes.content:
Beta Patch V 1.1 was released today.

This optional Beta is intended for users experiencing the following issues:

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b][list]
     [*]Fixed bug where BGM and voices would randomly stop.
     [*]Fixed white screen freeze after solving certain puzzle rooms.
[/list] 
To access the Beta branch, open the Steam Launcher. Then go to:

Library > Right click on “Zero Escape: Zero Time Dilemma” > Properties > Beta > From drag-down menu, select: patch_100 – Patch V 1.1

We are still looking into other major issues reported by players. If you experience issues due to the Beta patch, please [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/311240/discussions/1/359543542235196319/]let us know on the forums[/url]. 

Thank you for your patience and understanding

notes.title: BONUS DLC UPDATE
notes.content:
We accidentally created a time paradox by offering pre-order items with no way to pre-order. BUT! We have a way to fix it and apologize for any confusion.

The Mini-OST and Premium Booklet will be available for free as a bundle from launch through July 8, 18:00 PST.

Read on for details about the DLC:
[list]
     [*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/471420/]Mini-OST[/url] 
     [*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/471520/]Premium Booklet[/url] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25221096/b6aed974455d13deef09dfed24a5d1f957b5437f.jpg[/img]
[/list]
